Islands & water

Batu Kareta Island

Batu Kareta is mentioned as a point in Painan bay, but access data and status are limited. This page states what is known and what is unverified.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Status

Limited data

Information about Batu Kareta as an island or rock formation in Painan bay is not independently verified by us. Do not assume this point has official tourist access.

  • Ask locals or staff in Painan for current guidance.
  • Do not lock plans to this point without confirmation.
  • Treat it as bay landscape, not a fixed destination.

Bridge

Connecting route?

Some narratives mention a bridge or connecting path in the bay area. We do not verify its existence or access; treat it as background, not a promised route.

Confirm on site

If Batu Kareta is cited elsewhere, verify with staff before making it a travel destination.

Alternative

Bay landscape

As part of the bay landscape, the point can enrich observation from Pantai Carocok without a separate crossing.

Questions

Before you go

01Can Batu Kareta be visited?+

We do not independently verify Batu Kareta access. Do not assume official tourist access; ask staff in Painan.

02Is there a bridge there?+

Narratives about a bridge are unverified. Treat as background, not a certain route promise.

03How is it different from Cingkuak?+

Cingkuak is better known as a crossing destination; our Batu Kareta data is more limited. Confirm both at the jetty.

04Where to view it?+

From the edge of Pantai Carocok, the bay faces several island points. Use it for landscape observation.
